maddeler.e:
تقتتلين (form VIII)
# تَقْتَتِلِينَ (taqtatilīna) /taq.ta.ti.liː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past active indicative of اِقْتَتَلَ (iqtatala)
# تُقْتَتَلِينَ (tuqtatalīna) /tuq.ta.ta.liː.na/: second-person feminine singular non-past passive indicative of اُقْتُتِلَ (uqtutila)
maddeler.t: See the etymology of the corresponding lemma form.
